scope: Training and validation artifacts only; no test data or samples read or generated.
forecast_checkpoint_selection: Minimum fixed-ensemble original-grid validation CRPS among epochs 100,200,300,400,500,600.
densifier_checkpoint_selection: Minimum fixed-noise alternating-mask validation denoising MSE every 50 epochs.
recent_loss_definition: Unweighted mean of per-epoch training denoising losses; all epochs contain the same number of training examples. Epoch variation includes sampled diffusion noise and dropout.
cautions: Denoising losses on different target grids are not comparable forecasting scores.
Small endpoint changes under a scheduled learning rate of 1e-5 are evidence of a local plateau under this schedule, not proof of optimization or statistical convergence.
All forecaster selected checkpoints occur at the final candidate epoch, so additional training could still improve performance.
Validation curves use fixed sampling seeds and 64 pooled draws. They have finite-ensemble error and do not establish population-level significance.
These training and validation observations cannot by themselves assign a cause to resolution transfer, synthetic future supervision, or optimization difficulty.

assessment.convergence: Forecast validation CRPS changes are smaller from 500 to 600 than from 400 to 500 for all methods and seeds, especially Densiffusion. The final learning rate is 1e-5 (1% of its initial value). This supports a near-plateau under the specified training schedule, not a convergence claim; every forecaster still selects the final checkpoint.
assessment.validation_only_method_comparison: Learned Densiffusion validation CRPS is substantially worse than both direct and linear baselines for all three seeds. This is a validation observation, not the held-out test result.
